---
title: "Weights & Biases"
---

[Weights & Biases](https://wandb.ai) is a platform for manage sweeps and tracking experiments. At a basic level it can be used to track the progress of your training runs and to serve as a record of experiments you've done. For regular training runs this can be enabled by setting these options in a training config:


```yaml
logger:
  use_wandb: true
  project: your_existing_weights_and_biases_project
  tags: [] #any tags you'd like to apply to the run for organisation
```

:::{.callout-tip}
You'll need to make a free Weights and Biases account if you don't have one.
:::

Here's an example of the sort of information you can get at a glance:



![Screenshot of a Weights & Biases dashboard for a Metis training run](images/example_wandb.png)


Once launched, Weights & Biases collects all the runs in a sweep together, allows you to sort the runs by key metrics (e.g. final validation loss) and computes things like hyperparameter correlation with validation loss:


![Screenshot of a Weights & Biases parameter correlation for a sweep](images/parameter_correlation.png)

For more advanced use cases its also possible to download the raw results for local analysis.
